cards.title: CSS styles your page
cards.body: CSS sets how things look. Put it in a `<style>` tag. A rule names what to style, then sets properties inside `{ }`.

hi.title: CSS aapke page ko style karta hai
hi.body: CSS batata hai cheezein kaisi dikhengi. Ise `<style>` tag mein rakho. Rule pehle batata hai kya style karna hai, phir `{ }` ke andar properties set karta hai.

cards.title: property: value;
cards.body: Each line inside the braces is `property: value;`. Don't forget the colon and the semicolon.
cards.code: Loud heading

hi.title: property: value;
hi.body: Braces ke andar har line `property: value;` hoti hai. Colon aur semicolon mat bhoolna.

cards.title: Spot the bug
cards.body: The heading should be purple, but stays black. Tap the bug.

bug.fix: Each line in a rule is `property: value;`. Line 2 is missing the colon: `color: purple;`.

hi.title: Bug dhoondo
hi.body: Heading purple honi chahiye, par kaali hi rehti hai. Bug par tap karo.
hi.fix: Rule ki har line `property: value;` hoti hai. Line 2 mein colon missing hai: `color: purple;`.

check.question: Which rule makes paragraphs red?
check.explanation: A CSS rule is a selector, then `property: value;` inside curly braces.

hi.question: Kaunsa rule paragraphs ko laal banata hai?
hi.explanation: CSS rule ek selector hai, phir curly braces ke andar `property: value;`.

exercise.prompt: Add a `<style>` tag and make the `<h1>` orange with the `color` property.
exercise.promptHi: Ek `<style>` tag jodo aur `color` property se `<h1>` ko orange banao.
